extraction_warnings: This paper primarily reports aggregate/group-level statistics (mouse experiments, in vitro isolates, RA patient cohorts) rather than a per-sample metadata table; most sample-level schema fields (subject_id, sample_id, age, sex, country, ancestry) could not be extracted from the provided text and are marked not_reported.

Multiple DNA extraction kits (MoBio Powersoil, ZymoBIOMICS, Wizard SV 96) and sequencing platforms (MiSeq, HiSeq2500, NovaSeq) were used across different sub-experiments; only the platform/kit used for the primary human RA patient 16S-seq cohort was extracted, with conflicts noted.
The paper_id (33440172) was not confirmed as the PMID within the provided text, so the pmid field was left not_reported per extraction rules.
Country was inferred only indirectly from institution name (NYU) and not explicitly stated in the text.
No supplementary tables (e.g., Table S1A/S1B/S1C with per-patient demographic data) were included in the provided text, limiting extraction of age, sex, ancestry, and subject-level identifiers.

This paper is a microbiome/immunology study of methotrexate effects on RA patients and gnotobiotic mice; many schema fields (zygosity, BMI, neonatal, obgyn, tumor staging, HLA) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

Disease and treatment fields combine information from multiple donor/patient subgroups (healthy Donor 1 vs. RA patients/Donors 2-6/NYU NORA cohort); granularity was set to study_level for simplicity, but some values are subgroup-specific (noted in field notes).

Age (18+) and antibiotic-use non-inclusion are inclusion/exclusion criteria for the NYU RA cohort specifically, not necessarily applicable to other donors (Donors 1-6) whose demographic details are not fully reported in main text.
fmt_id and fmt_role values were derived by aggregating donor references scattered across Results and Methods sections; no single table/quote lists all six donors together in the provided text.

Schema fields (OS, ECOG, tumor size) appear designed for oncology clinical trial papers and are largely not applicable to this microbiome/rheumatoid arthritis mechanistic study; most were marked not_reported.
biomarker_name/value/unit fields were populated with DAS28 as the closest matching disease-activity biomarker mentioned in the paper, though this may not fully match the intended schema use-case.
host_species field required a single string but the study involves two host species (human donors/patients and gnotobiotic mice); both were reported together as free text.

feces_phenotype_value could not be mapped to a specific quantitative field; extensive qualitative descriptions of microbiome/fecal community changes exist but no single 'feces_phenotype' variable was defined in the text.
No per-sample rows from the article's own tables; falling back to the SRA/ENA run manifest (1 table(s)).
